scope.summary: Implement cross-references inserting references to paragraphs or named text anchors using editable formats assembled from building blocks (page number, paragraph text/number, chapter number, file name) with a character style, flagging stale/broken references in preflight (MT-183). Implement named text anchors providing hyperlink and cross-reference destinations at exact text positions across documents. Cross-reference formats participate in book synchronization (MT-172).
acceptance_criteria: cross-references from building-block formats + named anchors across documents; stale/broken flagged
proof_targets: cross-ref resolution runtime; anchor + stale-flag test
expected_tests: live: cross-reference resolves from building-block format (page/para-text/para-number/chapter/file) with character style
test: named text anchor destination at exact position across documents; stale/broken flagged for preflight

risk_if_missed: No cross-references or named anchors; navigation and 'see page N' constructs impossible; stale refs undetected.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
